How old is Derek Harper?

Derek Harper is 64 years old.

Derek Harper was born in Elberton, Georgia.

Derek Harper was born on October 13, 1961.

Derek Harper is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much did Derek Harper weigh when playing?

Derek Harper weighed 185 lbs (83 kg) when playing.

Is Derek Harper in the Hall of Fame?

Derek Harper is not in the Hall of Fame.

Derek Harper was drafted by Dallas Mavericks, 1st round (11th pick, 11th overall), 1983 NBA Draft.

What position did Derek Harper play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

When did Derek Harper retire?

Derek Harper last played in 1999.

What is Derek Harper's net worth?

Derek Harper made at least $18,769,700 playing professional basketball.

How much did Derek Harper make?

Derek Harper made $2,837,000 in 1996.

What did Derek Harper average?

Derek Harper averaged 13.3 points, 2.4 rebounds, and 5.5 assists per game.

How many rings does Derek Harper have?

Derek Harper won 0 championships.

What schools did Derek Harper attend?

Derek Harper attended North Shore in West Palm Beach, Florida and Illinois.

What are Derek Harper's nicknames?

Harp is a nickname for Derek Harper.
